Title: 12 Angry Men
Hint: Twelve strangers must find absolute certainty within the suffocating heat of a locked room while a life hangs in the balance.
Description: A jury holdout attempts to prevent a miscarriage of justice by forcing his colleagues to reconsider the evidence.

Title: Seven Samurai
Hint: A desperate village trades their only sustenance for the protection of steel-bound outcasts before the harvest bloodbath.
Description: In 16th-century Japan, a veteran samurai gathers six other masterless warriors to defend a group of farmers from a band of marauding bandits who plan to steal their crops after the harvest.

Title: Harakiri
Hint: An aging warrior requests a final act of dignity while exposing the rot behind a noble facade.
Description: A masterless samurai arrives at a prominent estate seeking a place to die, only to challenge the very core of the bushido code through a tale of systemic cruelty.

Title: Grave of the Fireflies
Hint: Two siblings seek refuge in the shadows of a burning sky where tiny lanterns offer the only warmth before the inevitable darkness.
Description: A devastating tale of survival in wartime Japan follows two siblings as they struggle against hunger and neglect after their home is destroyed.

Title: Modern Times
Hint: A frantic struggle against the gears of industry leads to a silent path toward a hopeful sunrise.
Description: A factory worker struggles to survive in a modern, industrialized world with the help of a young homeless woman.

Title: Woman in the Dunes
Hint: A collector of small lives becomes a prisoner of shifting mountains where survival is measured in buckets.
Description: An entomologist seeking rare insects becomes trapped in a deep sand pit with a lonely widow, forced into a cycle of endless labor against the encroaching dunes.

Title: The World of Apu
Hint: A young writer navigates the unexpected burdens of love and loss amidst the rhythmic pulse of the railway and the weight of a sudden legacy.
Description: The final chapter of a landmark trilogy follows a sensitive artist in Calcutta as he faces the joys of marriage and the crushing depths of grief.

Title: Gol Maal
Hint: A clean-shaven lie splits one man into two to appease a traditionalist's obsession with facial hair.
Description: A sports-loving accountant invents a fictional twin to save his job when his traditionalist boss catches him at a match.

Title: 3 Idiots
Hint: A rebellious pursuit of knowledge challenges a rigid educational system through the lens of long-lost friendship.
Description: Two friends search for their long-lost companion who inspired them to think differently and face the world with courage, even as they remember their college days under the tyranny of a strict director.

Title: Witness for the Prosecution
Hint: A silver-tongued defender faces a maze of deception where the most damning testimony comes from the one meant to save him.
Description: A veteran barrister defends a man accused of murdering a wealthy widow, only for the case to take a series of shocking turns involving a mysterious wife.

Title: Sansho the Bailiff
Hint: A lost token of mercy guides broken spirits through a landscape of suffering toward a final, bittersweet reunion by the shore.
Description: In medieval Japan, a compassionate governor is exiled, leaving his wife and children to be captured by human traffickers and sold into a brutal labor camp.

Title: The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix
Hint: High atop a peak, a modest inventor and his feathered friends construct a copper-bellied beast to reclaim stolen glory in a high-speed duel.
Description: On the mountain of Pinchcliffe, a bicycle repairman and his two animal assistants build a super-powered car to compete in a high-stakes race against a treacherous former apprentice.

Title: Toy Story
Hint: The arrival of a modern rival forces a local leader to embark on a perilous journey across a concrete jungle to reclaim his place in a child's heart.
Description: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman figure renders him second-best in a boy's bedroom.

Title: Singin' in the Rain
Hint: A joyful splash accompanies the chaotic dawn of a new audible era in Tinseltown.
Description: A silent film star falls for a chorus girl just as he and his delusional leading lady struggle to transition to talking pictures in 1920s Hollywood.

Title: Ikiru
Hint: A paper-pusher finds the courage to build something lasting only after his days are numbered.
Description: A veteran bureaucrat in post-war Japan searches for meaning in his life after learning he has terminal stomach cancer.

Title: Red Beard
Hint: A proud young practitioner learns that the truest medicine lies in the soul of the impoverished.
Description: An aspiring young doctor is disappointed to be assigned to a rural clinic, but under the guidance of a stern, seasoned mentor, he discovers the profound impact of empathy and dedication to the poor.

Title: Ordet
Hint: In a landscape of rigid dogma and grieving hearts, a single spoken command challenges the very boundary between life and death.
Description: A multi-generational family on a Danish farm grapples with conflicting religious perspectives and a devastating loss that culminates in a profound miracle.

Title: Samurai Rebellion
Hint: A veteran blade-master shatters a lifetime of obedience to defend a forbidden love against a ruler's cruel decree.
Description: An aging swordsman and his son risk their lives and positions by refusing to obey an unjust order from their daimyo regarding the son's wife.

Title: Andhadhun
Hint: A witness who claims to see nothing finds himself trapped in a symphony of lethal deceptions and culinary betrayals.
Description: A talented piano player who pretends to be visually impaired becomes an accidental witness to a murder, spiraling into a chaotic web of lies and survival.

Title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
Hint: Gold's glitter turns brotherhood into a fatal dance of suspicion beneath the burning desert sun.
Description: Two down-on-their-luck Americans in Mexico join an old prospector to search for gold in the Sierra Madre Mountains, but greed soon consumes them.

Title: The Kid
Hint: A wandering soul discovers an abandoned life in an alleyway, forging an unbreakable bond amidst the struggles of the streets.
Description: A tramp finds an abandoned infant and raises him as his own, but their bond is tested when the child's past catches up to them.

Title: Close-Up
Hint: Identity and artifice collide when a cinephile inhabits another's life to find the respect he lacks in his own.
Description: The true story of Hossain Sabzian, a man who impersonated director Mohsen Makhmalbaf, told through a blend of documentary and reenactment.

Title: Ugetsu
Hint: A craftsman and a laborer abandon their families for hollow pursuits only to find that the spirits of the past hold the steepest price for greed.
Description: In war-torn 16th-century Japan, two peasants pursue wealth and military glory, encountering supernatural consequences that haunt their return to reality.

Title: A Brighter Summer Day
Hint: A flicker of light in a darkened alley leads to a tragic end for youth caught between political shadows and personal longing.
Description: Based on a real-life incident, this sprawling masterpiece explores the tensions of 1960s Taiwan through the lives of competing youth gangs.

Title: It's Such a Beautiful Day
Hint: A fragile mind navigates the mundane and the infinite as reality begins to splinter and fold.
Description: Bill struggles with his failing memory and surreal visions while trying to find meaning in his increasingly fragmented existence.

Title: Late Spring
Hint: The blooming season brings a quiet sacrifice as a devoted caretaker is urged to leave the nest she never wished to abandon.
Description: A widowed father and his daughter live in harmony, but societal pressures and the passage of time force a heartbreaking decision regarding her marriage and their shared domestic life.

Title: A Man Escaped
Hint: A patient architect of liberation crafts his salvation from the very stones and silence of his confinement.
Description: During World War II, a captured French Resistance fighter meticulously plans and executes a daring breakout from a high-security Nazi prison.

Title: I Am Cuba
Hint: A soaring camera witnesses the transformation of an island from a playground for the wealthy to a cradle of revolutionary fire.
Description: A visually revolutionary anthology film consisting of four vignettes that explore the lives of the Cuban people during the transition from the Batista regime to the Socialist revolution.

Title: Aparajito
Hint: A son's academic pursuit draws him away from the sacred river and a mother's lonely heart.
Description: The second installment of the Apu Trilogy follows a young man as he leaves his rural roots and grieving mother for an education in the bustling city.

Title: Il Sorpasso
Hint: A reckless chance encounter on a quiet holiday leads a timid student into a whirlwind of Mediterranean excess and sudden finality.
Description: During a quiet summer holiday in Rome, a brash extrovert convinces a studious law student to join him on a spontaneous, high-speed road trip along the Italian coast.

Title: I Am a Fugitive from a Chain Gang
Hint: A veteran seeks a peaceful life but finds himself trapped in a cycle of injustice where his only escape is to vanish into the shadows forever.
Description: An innocent World War I veteran is wrongly convicted of a crime and sentenced to a brutal southern chain gang, leading to a desperate struggle for freedom and a life on the run.

Title: The Terminator
Hint: A relentless visitor from a dark tomorrow arrives to erase a future savior before he can even exist.
Description: A cyborg assassin is sent from 2029 to 1984 to kill a waitress whose unborn son will one day save mankind from extinction.

Title: Before Sunrise
Hint: Two paths cross on a locomotive, leading to a finite odyssey of dialogue through a city that sleeps while they awaken.
Description: A young man and woman meet on a train in Europe and spend one evening together in Vienna, exploring the city and getting to know each other before their paths must diverge at dawn.

Title: Stalker
Hint: Beyond the cordoned threshold of a decaying world, a guide leads seekers to a room where their deepest truths manifest.
Description: In a post-apocalyptic future, a guide leads two men through a mysterious area known as the Zone to find a room that grants a person's innermost desires.

Title: Cool Hand Luke
Hint: A silver-tongued nonconformist challenges the heavy hand of authority with a stubborn spirit that refuses to be broken.
Description: A rebellious inmate at a Southern prison camp becomes a legend among his fellow prisoners by constantly defying the sadistic warden and guards.

Title: Tokyo Story
Hint: Gentle disappointment blooms when the anchors of the past meet the frantic currents of a changing world.
Description: An elderly couple travels to the capital to visit their busy grown children, discovering that they have become secondary to the demands of modern urban life.

Title: The Grapes of Wrath
Hint: A displaced family journeys across a desolate landscape in search of a promised land that only offers more struggle.
Description: During the Great Depression, a family of sharecroppers is driven from their Oklahoma home and sets out on a grueling journey toward the hope of work in the West.

Title: Three Colors: Red
Hint: A chance collision on a rainy road weaves an invisible thread between a compassionate soul and an embittered observer of private lives.
Description: The final installment of the Three Colors trilogy explores the theme of fraternity through the meeting of a young model and a reclusive retired judge who spends his days eavesdropping on his neighbors' phone conversations.

Title: Fanny and Alexander
Hint: A festive family chronicle dissolves into the chilling shadows of a stern and sanctimonious cell.
Description: In early 20th-century Sweden, two children find their vibrant lives upended when their widowed mother marries a rigid bishop.

Title: The Gold Rush
Hint: A solitary wanderer dances with dinner rolls while the icy wilderness tests the limits of greed and survival.
Description: A lone prospector ventures into the Alaskan wilderness during the Klondike Gold Rush, facing starvation, harsh weather, and eccentric rivals while searching for love and fortune.

Title: Where Is the Friend's House?
Hint: A simple mistake sends a determined child on a recursive journey across hills to save a peer from an unfair fate.
Description: An eight-year-old boy mistakenly takes his classmate's notebook home and must travel to a neighboring village to return it before the next school day.

Title: A Special Day
Hint: Two outcasts find a fleeting connection in the silence of an apartment complex while a parade of tyranny roars through the streets outside.
Description: During a day of fascist celebration in 1930s Rome, a lonely housewife and a persecuted radio broadcaster discover a transformative intimacy within their secluded domestic space.

Title: Pink
Hint: When a night out turns into a legal nightmare, an aging eagle emerges from retirement to prove that a simple refusal requires no further explanation.
Description: A retired lawyer defends three young women against a group of influential men in a case that challenges deep-seated societal prejudices and the concept of consent.

Title: The Heiress
Hint: A fortune becomes a cage where affection is weighed against gold and a cold heart finds its strength in isolation.
Description: A plain young woman falls in love with a handsome fortune hunter, much to the chagrin of her emotionally abusive, wealthy father.

Title: A Short Film About Love
Hint: A silent observer discovers that the distance of a lens cannot protect the heart from the reality of a shared touch.
Description: A young postal clerk's obsessive surveillance of an older woman in an adjacent housing project evolves into a bittersweet exploration of loneliness and longing.

Title: Farha
Hint: Through a crack in the cellar door, a witness watches her world disappear into the shadows of history.
Description: In 1948 Palestine, a young girl's dreams of education are shattered when she is hidden in a small storage room to survive a violent transition, witnessing the unthinkable through the cracks.

Title: The Last Picture Show
Hint: In a dying town where the wind never stops, the flicker of a projector fades along with the innocence of youth.
Description: A poignant drama exploring the social and sexual coming-of-age of teenagers in a small, stagnant Texas town during the early 1950s.

Title: The Shop Around the Corner
Hint: Two bickering coworkers find solace in anonymous letters, unaware they are pouring their hearts out to their workplace rival.
Description: Two employees at a leathergoods shop in Budapest can barely stand each other, but unwittingly fall in love through an anonymous correspondence.

Title: The Exterminating Angel
Hint: An invisible threshold prevents a group of socialites from departing a dinner party, forcing their refined masks to crumble into primal chaos.
Description: In this surrealist masterpiece, guests at an upscale dinner party find themselves psychologically trapped in a room they are physically able to leave, leading to a slow descent into madness and animalistic behavior.

Title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
Hint: Jagged shadows and distorted dreams reveal a waking nightmare controlled by a traveling showman.
Description: A landmark of German Expressionism, this silent masterpiece uses sharp, distorted visuals to tell the story of a traveling hypnotist who uses a somnambulist to commit murders.

Title: The Maltese Falcon
Hint: A cynical investigator navigates a web of lethal deceit to find a legendary golden bird that dreams are made of.
Description: A private eye takes on a case that involves him with three eccentric criminals, a gorgeous liar, and their quest for a priceless statuette.

Title: Anatomy of a Murder
Hint: A rural legal battle hinges on the thin line between a justifiable impulse and a calculated crime.
Description: A small-town defense attorney takes on a sensational case involving an army lieutenant who murdered the man who allegedly assaulted his wife.

Title: Mirror
Hint: Scattered reflections of a fading consciousness drift through burning barns and leaking roofs to find the mother who remains forever young.
Description: A dying poet's fragmented memories of childhood, family, and the wartime Soviet Union blend together in a non-linear, dream-like meditation on history and the soul.

Title: Le Samouraï
Hint: A silent shadow in a trench coat navigates a cold city, bound by a code that leads to an inevitable, tragic performance.
Description: A professional hitman who lives by a strict code of conduct finds himself caught between the police and his employers after a job goes wrong in a cold, blue-tinted Paris.

Title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
Hint: A missed train leads to a cross-continental quest to win the heart of a patriarch.
Description: A young man and woman fall in love during a vacation in Europe, but the woman's conservative father has already promised her hand in marriage to someone else in India.

Title: Quo Vadis, Aida?
Hint: A desperate race against an impending tide of shadow within a sanctuary that offers no true shelter.
Description: A United Nations translator struggles to save her family as a conflict-torn town is overrun by encroaching forces during a humanitarian crisis.

Title: Day for Night
Hint: A chaotic symphony of artifice and reality unfolds within the flickering light of a studio set.
Description: The film follows the production of a melodrama titled Meet Pamela, capturing the behind-the-scenes drama, technical challenges, and personal crises of the cast and crew.

Title: Ivan's Childhood
Hint: A fragmented soul navigates a landscape of mirrored waters and skeletal woods to gather secrets in a world that stole his innocence.
Description: During World War II, a young orphan works as a scout for the Soviet Army, moving through a grim landscape while his mind retreats into surreal, poetic memories of his lost youth.

Title: Kind Hearts and Coronets
Hint: A discarded branch of a family tree trims its own lineage with polite, calculated precision.
Description: A vengeful social outcast meticulously eliminates the eight heirs standing between him and an aristocratic title.

Title: The Cremator
Hint: He believes his purifying fire offers the only true liberation for souls as a cold ideology consumes the city.
Description: In 1930s Prague, a professional cremator who believes his work liberates the soul descends into madness and murder after joining the Nazi party.

Title: Rome, Open City
Hint: Resistance pulses through the shadows of an occupied capital while a final sacrifice echoes against the city walls.
Description: A landmark of neorealism following the intersecting lives of people struggling to survive and resist the Nazi occupation of their beloved city.

Title: Sanjuro
Hint: A scruffy master teaches nine naive pupils that the sharpest blade is the one that stays in its sheath.
Description: A cynical and scruffy ronin agrees to help a group of naive young warriors expose corruption within their clan, leading to a legendary standoff.

Title: Investigation of a Citizen Above Suspicion
Hint: A master of order tests the absolute limits of his immunity by painting a bloody portrait of his own guilt.
Description: A high-ranking police official murders his mistress and deliberately leaves clues to see if the law can ever touch a man of his stature.

Title: Winter Light
Hint: A small rural congregation faces the silence of the divine amidst the chilling reality of a nuclear shadow.
Description: Following the death of his wife, a village pastor finds his faith slipping away as he confronts the existential dread of his parishioners.

Title: Yol
Hint: A temporary release from the confines of stone leads back to the chains of tradition and a land under heavy watch.
Description: Five prisoners granted home leave find themselves still shackled by the harsh social and political realities of their homeland.

Title: Divorce Italian Style
Hint: A desperate aristocrat plots a lethal loophole to escape his matrimonial prison in a land where the law offers no exits.
Description: A Sicilian nobleman trapped in a loveless marriage schemes to catch his wife in an affair so he can kill her and marry his beautiful young cousin.

Title: An Autumn Afternoon
Hint: A lingering sense of duty forces a father to confront the inevitable silence of an empty house.
Description: In his final masterpiece, an aging patriarch navigates the social pressures and personal loneliness involved in arranging his daughter's marriage.

Title: The Bad Sleep Well
Hint: A grieving son navigates the heart of corporate rot to expose the men who drove his father to the brink.
Description: An executive's rise within a corrupt construction firm is actually a calculated infiltration by a man seeking vengeance for his father's forced suicide.

Title: The Phantom Carriage
Hint: A midnight clock strike binds a lost soul to the service of the collector of the departed.
Description: On New Year's Eve, a driver of a spectral wagon forces a drunken sinner to reflect on his wasted life and the pain he has caused others before his time runs out.

Title: The Last Laugh
Hint: A proud uniform is stripped away, leaving a man to face his reflection in the shadows of a revolving door.
Description: An aging hotel doorman's life collapses after he is demoted to a washroom attendant, losing his status and sense of identity.

Title: The Cameraman
Hint: A desperate suitor trades his portrait lens for a newsreel crank to capture a heart amidst a urban riot.
Description: A tintype photographer falls for a newsreel office worker and attempts to become a cameraman to be near her, leading to slapstick chaos and a heroic rescue.

Title: Toy Story 2
Hint: A plastic hero rediscovers his legendary origins while his friends embark on a hazardous journey across a suburban landscape.
Description: When a cowboy is stolen by an obsessive collector, his space-faring friend leads a rescue mission while the captive faces a life-changing decision about his own legacy.

Title: A Night to Remember
Hint: An unsinkable ambition meets the silent, frozen titan of the deep under a star-filled sky.
Description: The definitive cinematic account of the RMS Titanic's final night, based on Walter Lord's book, told from the perspective of passengers and crew.

Title: The Philadelphia Story
Hint: A high-society weekend of nuptial chaos hinges on whether a fiery debutante will choose the past, the present, or a charming interloper.
Description: A wealthy socialite's upcoming wedding is thrown into turmoil when her ex-husband and an inquisitive reporter arrive to cover the event.

Title: Kes
Hint: A captive spirit finds its only tether to the sky through the eyes of a neglected youth in a harsh industrial landscape.
Description: Billy Casper is a bullied schoolboy in a bleak Yorkshire mining town who escapes his troubled home life and school by training a wild kestrel.

Title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
Hint: A rogue marksman in green leads a band of rebels to reclaim a kingdom from a greedy usurper while the rightful ruler is away.
Description: The quintessential swashbuckler film featuring a noble outlaw who steals from the rich to give to the poor in Technicolor glory.

Title: Laura
Hint: An investigator falls in love with a painted face only to discover the supposed victim is very much alive.
Description: A police detective finds himself captivated by the portrait and reputation of a murdered advertising executive, leading to a shocking discovery that changes the nature of his investigation.

Title: Tampopo
Hint: A roadside search for the ultimate culinary craft transforms into a series of sensual vignettes about human desire.
Description: A pair of truck drivers stop at a run-down roadside ramen shop and decide to help the widowed owner transform it into the best establishment in town through rigorous training and secret recipes.

Title: My Man Godfrey
Hint: A scavenger hunt leads a wealthy socialite to find a new sense of purpose in the most unlikely of city dumps.
Description: A ditzy socialite wins a scavenger hunt by finding a forgotten man at a city dump and hires him as her family's butler, unaware of his true pedigree.

Title: The Big Heat
Hint: A relentless quest for justice in a city soaked in shadow leads to a scalding confrontation that scars both the guilty and the innocent.
Description: After a colleague's suicide, a detective uncovers widespread corruption within the city's police force and a powerful crime syndicate.

Title: Battleship Potemkin
Hint: A cascading carriage signals the bloody start of a revolution on the waves.
Description: A landmark of silent cinema that dramatizes a mutiny at sea and the subsequent massacre on a famous flight of steps.

Title: Angels with Dirty Faces
Hint: One man chooses the path of the collar while his brother in spirit walks the road to the electric chair.
Description: A childhood prank gone wrong splits two friends onto opposite sides of the law, leading to a final act of deceptive cowardice for the sake of the next generation.

Title: Still Walking
Hint: A day of shared meals and quiet walks reveals the enduring weight of a ghost that never truly left the family table.
Description: Over the course of a single summer day, an elderly couple is visited by their grown children, who have gathered to commemorate the tragic accidental death of the eldest son fifteen years ago.

Title: Sullivan's Travels
Hint: A seeker of truth discovers that laughter is the only shield against the weight of a broken world.
Description: A director of lighthearted comedies sets out on a journey of self-discovery to document the plight of the common man, only to find the true value of humor.

Title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
Hint: A lifetime of quiet devotion is measured by the thousands of footsteps that passed through his classroom and the one heart that changed him forever.
Description: The moving chronicle of an earnest English schoolteacher whose stiff demeanor is transformed by a spirited woman, leading to a long legacy of influence over generations of students.

Title: Letter from an Unknown Woman
Hint: A lifetime of silent devotion is finally unveiled through ink and paper as a dying flame recounts a passion that was never truly shared.
Description: In early 20th-century Vienna, a woman's lifelong unrequited obsession with a concert pianist is revealed through a letter she writes to him on her deathbed.

Title: The Little Foxes
Hint: A predatory family tears itself apart in a ruthless pursuit of southern industrial wealth.
Description: In the post-Civil War South, a manipulative matriarch and her greedy brothers engage in a vicious struggle for control of the family business, leading to ultimate betrayal.

Title: The Roaring Twenties
Hint: Three comrades return from the trenches only to find their destinies shaped by illegal spirits and a crumbling empire.
Description: An epic crime drama following three veterans from the battlefields of World War I to the prohibition-era underworld of New York City.

Title: Trouble in Paradise
Hint: When two elite swindlers cross paths in a city of lights, their shared craft leads to a high-stakes triangle where loyalty is as thin as a champagne flute.
Description: A suave thief and a pickpocket team up to rob a wealthy widow, but their plan hits a snag when one of them begins to develop genuine feelings for the target.

Title: Mary Poppins
Hint: A descent from the clouds brings a spoonful of wonder to a soot-covered city.
Description: A magical nanny visits a dysfunctional family in London and uses her unique lifestyle to improve the family's dynamic.

Title: The Man from Earth
Hint: A simple farewell party shifts into an intellectual odyssey when a host claims his life has spanned the entirety of recorded history.
Description: An impromptu goodbye party for a departing professor becomes an interrogation after he reveals a secret about his true age and origin.

Title: Frankenstein
Hint: Reanimated parts seek a place in a world that only knows how to fear what it has created.
Description: An obsessed scientist assembles a living being from exhumed body parts, only to face the tragic consequences of playing God.

Title: Great Expectations
Hint: A windfall from a mysterious source leads a commoner into a decaying manor where time has frozen for a jilted bride.
Description: A humble orphan's life is transformed when a mysterious benefactor enables him to join the upper class, leading to a journey of love and self-discovery.

Title: Stagecoach
Hint: A disparate group journeys across a dangerous desert landscape while past sins and external threats collide within their moving wooden sanctuary.
Description: A group of travelers on a stagecoach find their journey complicated by personal secrets and the threat of an Apache uprising in the American West.

Title: Shadow of a Doubt
Hint: A visitor's arrival in a quiet town gradually reveals that a charming smile can mask the coldest of hearts.
Description: A young woman's admiration for her visiting namesake turns to terror as she uncovers clues linking him to a string of high-profile murders across the country.

Title: L'Atalante
Hint: Life drifts along a winding river where dreams and reality blur amidst the fog of new love and nautical isolation.
Description: A newly married couple navigates the joys and challenges of life aboard a river barge alongside an eccentric crew member.

Title: Red River
Hint: A monumental journey across a lawless land pits an iron-willed patriarch against his defiant protege.
Description: A ruthless cattle baron leads a massive herd toward Missouri, but his tyrannical leadership during the arduous trek triggers a mutiny.

Title: They Shoot Horses, Don't They?
Hint: Desperate souls shuffle in circles for coins while the clock ticks down to a mercy kill.
Description: During the Great Depression, a disparate group of contestants enters a grueling dance marathon in hopes of winning a cash prize.

Title: Vivre Sa Vie
Hint: Twelve fragments observe a soul’s slow drift from silver screen dreams into the transactional shadows of the city.
Description: Divided into twelve distinct chapters, the film follows a young Parisian woman who abandons her family to seek a career in acting, only to succumb to the harsh realities of social and economic pressures.

Title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
Hint: A lonely woman shares her seaside life with a sailor whose presence remains anchored long after his departure.
Description: A young widow moves into a seaside cottage that is haunted by the spirit of its former owner, a salty sea captain.

Title: Au hasard Balthazar
Hint: A silent witness endures the heavy burden of human cruelty and grace through a lifetime of shifting hands.
Description: A cinematic masterpiece tracing the parallel lives of a stoic beast of burden and a young woman, illustrating the spectrum of human morality.

Title: Ninotchka
Hint: A stern ideology dissolves when cold discipline meets the sparkling allure of the City of Light.
Description: An icy Soviet envoy sent to Paris to retrieve defecting comrades finds her rigid ideologies melting under the warmth of Western luxury and unexpected romance.

Title: I Vitelloni
Hint: Five overgrown boys drift through the aimless rhythms of a seaside town, waiting for a life that has already begun.
Description: Five aimless young men waste their lives away in a small Italian town, dreaming of adventure and women while avoiding the responsibilities of adulthood.

Title: Seven Chances
Hint: A desperate race against time for a massive fortune sparks a matrimonial stampede and a literal landslide of trouble.
Description: A man discovers he stands to inherit seven million dollars if he can find a bride and marry by seven o'clock on his twenty-seventh birthday.

Title: Breaker Morant
Hint: Soldiers operating in a moral gray zone find themselves sacrificed on the altar of imperial diplomacy under the harsh glare of a colonial sun.
Description: During the Second Boer War, three Australian lieutenants are court-martialed for executing prisoners, a trial that serves as a political scapegoat for the British Empire's own brutal tactics.

Title: Steamboat Bill, Jr.
Hint: A cyclone tests the strength of a son's spirit as walls crumble around his deadpan resolve.
Description: A college-educated youth returns to his father's riverboat business and must prove his worth when a massive storm threatens the entire town.

Title: The Man from Nowhere
Hint: A reclusive shopkeeper descends into a violent underworld to rescue the only light in his dark world.
Description: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring to save a young girl who is his only friend.

Title: Black Narcissus
Hint: Isolation at high altitudes unravels the discipline of a sacred order as suppressed desires bleed into the thin mountain air.
Description: A group of Anglican nuns faces spiritual and emotional crises while attempting to establish a school and hospital in the remote Himalayas.

Title: Scarlet Street
Hint: A master of the canvas finds his life rewritten by a deceptive muse and a guilt that no shadow can hide.
Description: A middle-aged cashier and amateur painter becomes entangled with a manipulative woman and her boyfriend, leading to a tragic spiral of betrayal and murder.

Title: Marty
Hint: An ordinary man steps out of his routine to find a rare spark in a world that tells him he is finished.
Description: A socially awkward middle-aged butcher from the Bronx lives with his mother and searches for love despite his own self-doubt and societal expectations.

Title: My Darling Clementine
Hint: Justice blooms in a lawless desert town where a simple haircut precedes a legendary showdown at a cattle enclosure.
Description: After his brother is murdered, a cattleman becomes the marshal of Tombstone to exact justice, leading to a legendary confrontation at the O.K. Corral.

Title: Holiday
Hint: A free spirit finds kinship in a high-society attic while the rest of the world counts their pennies and reputations.
Description: A man from humble beginnings falls in love with a wealthy woman, only to find that her unconventional sister is the one who truly shares his dream of living life outside the constraints of corporate greed.

Title: Love and Death
Hint: A cowardly intellectual debates God and mortality while failing to navigate a historical invasion and his own heart.
Description: A neurotic pacifist in 19th-century Russia is forced to join the army during the Napoleonic Wars and accidentally becomes a war hero while pondering existential philosophy.

Title: The Great Silence
Hint: In a world of biting cold and frozen hearts, a mute stranger challenges the law of the greedy where justice rarely survives the winter.
Description: During the Great Blizzard of 1899, a mute gunfighter must protect a group of outlaws and a widow from a band of sadistic bounty hunters in the snow-covered mountains of Utah.

Title: Captain Blood
Hint: A condemned physician escapes a life of servitude to command a fleet and seek justice under a black flag.
Description: A wrongly convicted doctor is sold into slavery but escapes to become a legendary pirate seeking revenge and love.

Title: Top Hat
Hint: A case of mistaken identity leads to a rhythmic chase across European suites and stages.
Description: An American screwball musical comedy film featuring iconic dance sequences where a professional dancer travels to London and Venice and falls for a woman who mistakes him for his producer.

Title: Vagabond
Hint: A nomad's frozen journey ends where it began, leaving behind only the fragmented memories of those who briefly crossed her path.
Description: A young woman wanders through the French countryside during a harsh winter, meeting various people while her past remains a mystery.

Title: The Lady Eve
Hint: A deceptive deck of cards and a literal fall lead to a second chance at love under a false name.
Description: On a transatlantic liner, a sophisticated con artist targets a naive brewery heir and snake expert, only to find herself genuinely falling for him despite her original scheme.

Title: Ball of Fire
Hint: Seven cloistered linguists find their academic sanctuary disrupted by a streetwise performer fleeing from a dangerous shadow.
Description: A group of ivory-tower professors researching an encyclopedia of human knowledge are forced to confront the modern world when a slang-talking nightclub singer hides out in their home to avoid testifying against her mobster boyfriend.

Title: Kapoor & Sons
Hint: Beneath the festive surface of a homecoming, long-buried resentments and hidden lives threaten to shatter the foundation of a generational legacy.
Description: Two estranged brothers return to their family home in Coonoor to visit their ailing grandfather, leading to a series of confrontations that expose the fragility of their domestic harmony.

Title: Mouchette
Hint: A young soul finds the weight of a cruel world too heavy to carry near a riverbank.
Description: A mistreated adolescent girl living in a rural French village faces a series of humiliations and hardships that push her toward a tragic fate.

Title: The Awful Truth
Hint: A separating couple engages in a sophisticated game of romantic sabotage before their legal ties are officially severed.
Description: After a misunderstanding leads to a divorce filing, a socialite couple spends their ninety-day waiting period hilariously undermining each other's attempts to find new love.

Title: Mind Game
Hint: A second chance at existence begins with a bullet to the rear and ends inside the belly of a leviathan.
Description: After a fatal encounter with the yakuza, a young man finds himself in a surreal purgatory where he must reclaim his soul and escape the confines of a giant sea creature to truly live.

Title: The Official Story
Hint: A teacher's search for the truth about her child exposes the shadows of a regime's stolen legacy.
Description: In the wake of the Argentine Dirty War, a high school history teacher begins to suspect that her adopted daughter may be the child of a 'disappeared' political prisoner.

Title: Ivan the Terrible, Part I
Hint: A monolithic leader emerges from the shadows of architectural art to forge a unified land through blood and betrayal.
Description: The first part of Sergei Eisenstein's epic historical drama chronicles the rise of the first Tsar of Russia as he battles internal enemies to solidify his reign.

Title: Better Days
Hint: A shared promise of protection binds two outcasts in a harsh world where silence is a weapon and hope is a distant light.
Description: A bullied high school student and a small-time street thug become the prime suspects in the murder of a teenage girl in this gritty, emotional drama about the scars of youth.

Title: One Cut of the Dead
Hint: A chaotic shoot behind the scenes reveals that finishing the take is more important than surviving the undead.
Description: A film crew's low-budget zombie movie takes a sudden turn when they are attacked by real zombies during a single, uninterrupted shot.

Title: Only Yesterday
Hint: A nostalgic train ride to the rural harvest forces a reflection on the unfulfilled dreams of a younger self.
Description: A 27-year-old office worker takes a break from her life in Tokyo to visit the countryside, where childhood memories begin to resurface and reshape her perspective on her future.

Title: My Life as a Dog
Hint: A boy finds comfort in the face of grief by comparing his situation to a creature launched into the stars.
Description: In the late 1950s, a mischievous Swedish boy is sent away to stay with relatives when his mother falls ill, leading to a poignant journey of discovery and resilience.

Title: The Ladykillers
Hint: A criminal quintet posing as a string ensemble finds their perfect heist undone by a sweet widow's moral persistence.
Description: A gang of eccentric thieves rents a room from an elderly widow under the guise of being a musical group, but their plan to eliminate her after a heist leads to their own comical undoing.

Title: The Public Enemy
Hint: A ruthless rise through a dry underworld culminates in a rain-soaked delivery at the family doorstep.
Description: A young hoodlum rises through the ranks of the Chicago underworld during the Prohibition era before facing a tragic and iconic downfall.

Title: Lady Snowblood
Hint: Born in a prison of shadows, a child of vengeance blooms in the crimson snow to settle a debt inherited from a broken mother.
Description: A young woman is raised from birth to be an instrument of revenge against the group of criminals who destroyed her family.

Title: Winchester '73
Hint: A prized possession passes through many hands as a man relentlessly hunts the one who stole it.
Description: A marksman tracks down his stolen one-of-a-thousand repeating rifle through the hands of a series of diverse owners across the rugged Western frontier.

Title: Bad Genius
Hint: A high-stakes operation turns international time zones into a weapon against a rigid academic system.
Description: A top student starts a cheating business that eventually leads her to a high-stakes mission in Australia to rig an international university entrance exam.

Title: Le rayon vert
Hint: A lonely wanderer seeks a momentary flash of color at twilight to unlock the secrets of a destiny yet unwritten.
Description: A sensitive Parisian woman finds herself drifting through a summer vacation alone, searching for a sign from nature to guide her heart.

Title: Only Angels Have Wings
Hint: High above the jagged peaks, the mail must fly through a thick veil of fog where any mistake is met with a cold and final silence.
Description: The manager of an airmail service in the Andes must balance the safety of his pilots against the demands of the business while dealing with personal ghosts and a newcomer.

Title: Odd Man Out
Hint: A wounded fugitive wanders through a labyrinth of shadows and conscience as his life slowly ebbs away into the cold city night.
Description: Following a botched factory heist, a wounded Irish nationalist leader struggles to evade the police in the dark and wintry streets of Belfast.

Title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
Hint: A vengeful student survives grueling trials of discipline to return power to the oppressed.
Description: After a brutal government massacre, a young man seeks refuge at a legendary temple, mastering thirty-five specialized training rooms to become a master of combat.

Title: Destry Rides Again
Hint: A silver-tongued lawman tries to tame a rowdy frontier town while strictly adhering to a policy of no firearms.
Description: A mild-mannered deputy who refuses to carry a gun is hired to clean up a lawless town, while a fiery saloon singer finds herself caught between her corrupt boss and the new law.

Title: Closely Watched Trains
Hint: In a quiet station under foreign shadows, an awkward transition to adulthood finds its rhythm alongside a secret mission of steel and fire.
Description: An apprentice dispatcher at a rural railway station in occupied Czechoslovakia navigates the awkwardness of his first romantic encounter while getting caught up in a resistance plot to blow up a German ammunition train.

Title: The Passion of Anna
Hint: Four fractured lives intertwine on a desolate shore where hidden cruelties and silent screams bleed into the winter fog.
Description: On a remote island, four isolated souls grapple with psychological scars, infidelity, and the elusive nature of truth amidst a series of senseless animal killings.

Title: Neerja
Hint: A single selfless soul stands between a hijacked vessel and the ultimate sacrifice above the clouds.
Description: Based on a true story, this film follows the heroic actions of a young flight attendant who risks everything to save hundreds of passengers during a terrifying mid-air crisis.

Title: The Navigator
Hint: Two helpless socialites must navigate the vast isolation of an abandoned vessel drifting across the sea.
Description: A wealthy, pampered couple finds themselves adrift on an empty, massive ocean liner and must learn to survive.

Title: Fireworks Wednesday
Hint: Amidst the smoke and sparks of a city celebration, an outsider glimpses the quiet destruction of a domestic union.
Description: A young bride-to-be takes a temp job as a domestic cleaner for a family in Tehran, only to find herself entangled in a web of marital deceit and suspicion on the eve of the Persian New Year.

Title: M
Hint: A metropolitan police force and an organized criminal underworld simultaneously pursue an elusive individual responsible for a series of community disturbances.
Description: A foundational work of early German sound cinema that explores the procedural intersection of law enforcement and illicit syndicates during a city-wide manhunt.

Title: Robin Hood
Hint: A displaced nobleman organizes a resistance movement within a forested region to challenge local administrative corruption during a monarch's absence.
Description: The narrative chronicles the efforts of an outlawed archer and his associates to undermine the authority of a regent through tactical wealth redistribution and guerilla warfare.

Title: Pinocchio
Hint: An artisan's creation navigates a sequence of ethical dilemmas and environmental hazards during a quest for biological transformation.
Description: This 1940 animated feature follows a sentient marionette's journey through various social and predatory environments to validate its worthiness for humanity.

Title: Meet Me in St. Louis
Hint: A family residing in Missouri navigates domestic transitions and the prospect of relocation during the year leading up to a major international exposition.
Description: Set in 1903, the narrative tracks the Smith family's seasonal experiences and emotional responses to a proposed move to New York City, culminating in the opening of the Louisiana Purchase Exposition.

Title: The Petrified Forest
Hint: A group of individuals at a remote Arizona service station are detained by a band of fugitives during a transit delay.
Description: The narrative centers on a disillusioned writer and a young waitress at an isolated desert diner who find their fates intertwined when a gang of escaped convicts seeks refuge within the establishment.

Title: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
Hint: A series of interconnected animated segments based on British literary sources involving a collection of woodland characters and their interactions with a young boy.
Description: This 1977 feature serves as an anthology of previously released animated featurettes exploring the narrative arcs of stuffed animals within the Hundred Acre Wood.

Title: A Bittersweet Life
Hint: A high-ranking enforcer's decision to show leniency during an assignment leads to a systemic conflict with his employer.
Description: A stylized neo-noir exploration of loyalty and consequence within an urban organized crime hierarchy.

Title: Cyrano de Bergerac
Hint: A gifted poet with a prominent physical trait ghostwrites romantic correspondence for a charismatic but ineloquent comrade.
Description: A cinematic adaptation of the 1897 verse drama by Edmond Rostand, examining the disparity between external aesthetics and internal intellectual merit through the medium of epistolary courtship.

Title: Summer with Monika
Hint: Two young workers abandon their urban constraints for a seasonal excursion to a remote archipelago.
Description: A social realist exploration of two Swedish youths who attempt to evade societal obligations by retreating to a coastal environment during the warmer months.

Title: The Mark of Zorro
Hint: A Spanish nobleman returns to colonial California to adopt a double identity and challenge local governance through swordsmanship and subterfuge.
Description: Don Diego Vega returns to Los Angeles from Spain to find his father displaced by a corrupt regime, leading him to assume a masked persona to restore justice.

Title: Fist of Legend
Hint: A practitioner returns to a geopolitically occupied metropolitan center to investigate his instructor's death and uphold the honor of a martial arts institution.
Description: Set in 1937 Shanghai, the narrative follows a martial artist who discovers his master has died under suspicious circumstances during a challenge match, leading to a series of confrontations with local and foreign forces.

Title: The Lavender Hill Mob
Hint: A long-serving bank employee organizes a logistical maneuver to export high-value bullion disguised as mundane souvenir items.
Description: An unassuming bank clerk conspires with an eccentric manufacturer to intercept gold bullion and smuggle the material out of the country in the form of miniature scale models.

Title: The Letter
Hint: A plantation owner's wife faces legal scrutiny after an incident involving a firearm and a suppressed document in colonial Malaya.
Description: Set in colonial Malaya, the narrative follows a woman's claim of self-defense after a fatal shooting and the subsequent discovery of written correspondence that contradicts her testimony.

Title: Strike
Hint: A group of industrial employees orchestrates a cessation of labor in response to management policies in early 20th-century Eurasia.
Description: This silent-era feature explores the dynamics of labor relations and social unrest through the application of dialectical montage techniques.

Title: Curse of the Demon
Hint: An American academic investigating a colleague's demise encounters a group claiming to possess ancient transactional objects.
Description: A psychological study of skepticism versus the supernatural as a rationalist scientist confronts a practitioner of the occult following a mysterious death.

Title: The Thief of Bagdad
Hint: A dispossessed ruler and a resourceful street dweller collaborate to overturn a political usurpation involving mystical elements.
Description: A cinematic adaptation of Middle Eastern folklore focusing on the conflict between a deposed prince and a treacherous advisor, utilizing pioneering special effects for its era.

Title: Fort Apache
Hint: A career military officer assumes command of a remote outpost and experiences friction with his subordinates regarding strategic engagement.
Description: The narrative focuses on the internal hierarchical conflicts and external diplomatic challenges faced by a cavalry unit stationed at a desert fortification.

Title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
Hint: A consultant investigates an alleged supernatural threat linked to an ancestral inheritance in the English countryside.
Description: An analytical detective explores the geological and historical context of a remote moorland to debunk a long-standing family legend.

Title: Knife in the Water
Hint: A domestic pair invites a solitary traveler onto their vessel, resulting in a structural examination of conflict within a nautical setting.
Description: Roman Polanski's feature debut explores the escalating psychological tension and power dynamics between a successful sports journalist, his wife, and a hitchhiker during a weekend sailing trip.

Title: Broadway Danny Rose
Hint: A talent agent navigates a series of social and logistical complications involving a musical client and a New York organized crime family.
Description: A black-and-white narrative framed by a group of comedians recounting the career of a devoted yet struggling theatrical manager.

Title: The Dam Busters
Hint: A team of engineers and pilots develops specialized aeronautical technology to target strategic infrastructure during a global conflict.
Description: A historical dramatization detailing the research, development, and eventual deployment of bouncing bombs by the Royal Air Force's 617 Squadron against industrial targets during World War II.

Title: Fat City
Hint: Two male athletes navigate the professional and personal challenges of a localized boxing circuit in a mid-century California city.
Description: The narrative explores the parallel experiences of a veteran pugilist attempting a comeback and a novice entering the sport within a decaying urban environment.

Title: Detour
Hint: A musician traveling to California encounters unexpected logistical and legal complications following the death of a driver.
Description: A seminal low-budget film noir exploring themes of fatalism and chance as a hitchhiking pianist becomes entangled in a series of unfortunate events on a cross-country trip.

Title: Holiday Inn
Hint: A former stage performer establishes a seasonal hospitality venue to balance professional interests with personal lifestyle changes.
Description: An entertainer retires to a farm in Connecticut, transforming it into an inn open exclusively during public holidays, which triggers a series of professional and romantic conflicts.

Title: Monsieur Hulot's Holiday
Hint: A socially awkward protagonist navigates the structured routines of a seaside resort during the summer season.
Description: A French comedy directed by Jacques Tati that utilizes visual humor and sound design to observe the leisure activities of vacationers at a coastal hotel.

Title: A Room with a View
Hint: An Edwardian woman navigates evolving social expectations and personal choices following a journey from Florence to rural England.
Description: A cinematic adaptation of E.M. Forster's 1908 novel documenting the transition of social mores and interpersonal dynamics within the British upper-middle class.

Title: Old Yeller
Hint: A frontier youth assumes familial responsibilities and manages agricultural challenges alongside a stray canine companion in 19th-century Texas.
Description: Set in post-Civil War Texas, the narrative follows a teenager who manages his family's homestead while his father is away on a cattle drive, focusing on his relationship with a courageous stray dog.

Title: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part One
Hint: A masked investigator forms a strategic alliance with law enforcement to identify a perpetrator targeting members of a prominent organized crime syndicate during specific holidays.
Description: During the holiday season, a vigilante, a police captain, and a district attorney collaborate to solve a series of murders targeting a powerful crime family.

Title: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
Hint: A masked vigilante and local authorities attempt to resolve a year-long investigation into a series of targeted assassinations within a metropolitan criminal hierarchy.
Description: The concluding chapter of the adaptation based on the mid-1990s graphic novel series, documenting the resolution of a holiday-themed homicide case and the transition of city-wide power structures.

Title: To Strike
Hint: A group of industrial laborers engages in a coordinated cessation of activity to address workplace grievances.
Description: This cinematic study explores the structural escalation of industrial disputes and the organizational mechanics of early twentieth-century collective bargaining.

Title: Leave No Trace
Hint: A father and daughter navigate a transition from a secluded existence in a public park to structured social services.
Description: The film follows an Iraq War veteran and his teenage daughter who live off the grid in a Portland, Oregon park until a legal intervention necessitates their relocation and social reintegration.

Title: One Week
Hint: A newlywed couple attempts to assemble a prefabricated residence over the course of seven days using a modular kit.
Description: This silent short film examines the physical comedy and structural failures resulting from the systematic misinterpretation of construction instructions for a modular dwelling.

Title: The Young Offenders
Hint: Two adolescents navigate the rural Irish landscape on bicycles in search of a misplaced illicit cargo.
Description: A cinematic exploration of adolescent delinquency and peer dynamics set in County Cork, following a pursuit of a specific commodity following a maritime incident.

Title: Young and Innocent
Hint: A man wrongly accused of a capital crime seeks evidence of his innocence alongside the daughter of a local law enforcement official.
Description: Directed by Alfred Hitchcock, this British thriller concerns a young man fleeing from legal authorities to locate a key witness in a homicide investigation.

Title: Ink
Hint: Conflict arises between distinct metaphysical factions over the subconscious state of a primary subject.
Description: An independent production detailing a non-linear struggle between dream-manipulating entities within a metaphysical framework.

Title: War and Peace
Hint: Several aristocratic families navigate social shifts and military conflicts during the Napoleonic era.
Description: A comprehensive adaptation of Leo Tolstoy's novel documenting the lives of five Russian families during the early 19th-century conflicts with France.

Title: His House
Hint: A displaced couple must navigate the physical and psychological constraints of a government-mandated residence in the United Kingdom.
Description: An analytical examination of two individuals undergoing resettlement within a structural environment that presents anomalous psychological and physical stressors.

Title: The Housemaid
Hint: A middle-class household experiences internal structural instability following the recruitment of a new domestic employee.
Description: A cinematic study of domestic hierarchy and psychological pressure within a residential setting.

Title: Last Shift
Hint: A solitary practitioner of law enforcement finds her nocturnal surveillance shift converging with the unresolved architectural trauma of a vacated facility.
Description: Officer Jessica Loren is assigned to the final night shift at a closing police station, tasked with awaiting a hazardous materials crew. As the shift progresses, the protagonist experiences a series of auditory and visual hallucinations linked to the station's history involving a defunct cult. The narrative utilizes a claustrophobic singular location to explore the deterioration of the subject's psychological state as the boundary between past manifestations and present reality reaches a total collapse.

Title: Parasite
Hint: A subterranean family climbs upward only to find that blood is thicker than the rain flooding their basement.
Description: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy family and infiltrate their household by posing as unrelated, highly qualified individuals.

Title: Casablanca
Hint: In a city of desperate transitions, a cynical expatriate must choose between a past love and a noble cause.
Description: During World War II, an American expatriate running a nightclub in Morocco encounters a former lover and is faced with a moral dilemma when her husband, a fugitive resistance leader, arrives looking for passage to safety.

Title: Citizen Kane
Hint: A media mogul's final breath leaves a cryptic mystery that unravels the rise and fall of a lonely empire.
Description: The investigation into the meaning of a publishing tycoon's dying word reveals the complex life of a man who gained the world but lost his innocence.

Title: Lawrence of Arabia
Hint: A scholar is transformed into a mythic leader amidst the scorching dunes and the chaos of a vanishing empire.
Description: The story of T.E. Lawrence, the English officer who successfully united and led the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes during World War I in order to fight the Turks.

Title: A Separation
Hint: A domestic conflict over an elderly relative escalates into a web of legal accusations where social class and religious duty collide.
Description: A married couple faced with a difficult decision to improve the life of their child or stay in Iran to look after a deteriorating parent.

Title: Bicycle Thieves
Hint: A desperate search for stolen wheels reveals the crushing weight of a city that has run out of hope.
Description: In post-war Rome, a working-class man's livelihood is threatened when his essential bicycle is stolen, leading him and his young son on a desperate search through the city.

Title: Finding Nemo
Hint: A frantic father traverses the vast currents of the deep to reclaim his legacy from a glass-walled prison.
Description: After his son is captured in the Great Barrier Reef and taken to Sydney, a timid clownfish embarks on a journey to bring him home.

Title: L.A. Confidential
Hint: Behind the glitz of the city of angels lies a web of corruption where truth is buried under layers of badges and lipstick.
Description: In 1950s Los Angeles, three very different policemen investigate a series of murders with their own brand of justice.

Title: All About Eve
Hint: Fasten your seatbelts for a treacherous ascent where youth mirrors ambition to eclipse a fading legacy.
Description: An aging Broadway star's career and personal life are systematically dismantled by a supposedly naive fan who hides a ruthless drive for fame.

Title: How to Train Your Dragon
Hint: A misunderstood legacy is rewritten when a pariah finds common ground with the shadow of the night.
Description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

Title: The Third Man
Hint: Shadows stretch long across a divided city as a writer chases a ghost through the labyrinthine sewers of a shattered peace.
Description: In post-war Vienna, an American writer arrives to find his friend dead, only to discover a missing witness and a city teeming with black market secrets.

Title: It Happened One Night
Hint: A runaway finds her world upended when a chance encounter on a long-distance commute turns a scoop into a shared destiny.
Description: A spoiled heiress running away from her family is helped by a man who is actually a reporter looking for a story.

Title: The 400 Blows
Hint: A misunderstood youth searches for the sea while fleeing the cold indifference of a world that refuses to understand his heart.
Description: A young Parisian boy, Antoine Doinel, neglected by his parents and misunderstood by his teachers, turns to a life of petty crime and rebellion in this foundational masterpiece of the French New Wave.

Title: The Battle of Algiers
Hint: Resistance flickers in the shadows of narrow alleys as an occupied city grapples with the violent cost of liberation.
Description: A masterful, documentary-style recreation of the Algerian struggle for independence from French colonial rule during the 1950s.

Title: The Twilight Samurai
Hint: A humble widower must unsheathe his hidden talent when the sun sets on his era and duty calls from the shadows.
Description: In mid-19th century Japan, a low-ranking samurai struggles to balance the demands of his impoverished family life with the dangerous duties imposed by his clan during the final days of the Shogunate.

Title: The Night of the Hunter
Hint: A silver-tongued predator with tattooed knuckles stalks two innocents through a moonlit river landscape to reclaim a hidden fortune.
Description: A sinister traveling preacher relentlessly pursues two children across the Depression-era South to find the stolen money their father hid before his execution.

Title: Wolfwalkers
Hint: In a world of rigid walls and wild woods, a hunter discovers that the monsters she fears are actually the kindred spirits she belongs with.
Description: Set in 17th-century Ireland, a young apprentice hunter travels to Ireland with her father to wipe out the last wolf pack, but everything changes after she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.

Title: The Tale of The Princess Kaguya
Hint: A celestial gift discovered within a glowing stalk must choose between the constraints of nobility and the fleeting beauty of a mortal existence.
Description: Found inside a shining stalk of bamboo by an old bamboo cutter and his wife, a tiny girl grows rapidly into an exquisite young lady who enthralls all who encounter her, but ultimately she must confront her fate and her celestial origin.

Title: Song of the Sea
Hint: A silent child must reclaim her voice to guide ancient spirits back to the depths of the ocean.
Description: An Irish youth discovers that his mute sister is a selkie who must find her voice and free supernatural creatures from the spell of a Celtic goddess.

Title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
Hint: A stranded cosmic traveler discovers the warmth of childhood bonds while eluding authorities to signal his distant kin.
Description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape Earth and return to his home world.

Title: Shoplifters
Hint: Bonded by choice rather than birth, a ragtag group survives on stolen goods and shared warmth until a hidden truth threatens their fragile sanctuary.
Description: A family of small-time crooks take in a child they find outside in the cold, leading to a sequence of events that exposes the thin line between love and legality.

Title: 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days
Hint: A desperate race against time reveals the harrowing moral cost of basic autonomy within a suffocating totalitarian state.
Description: In the final years of communist Romania, two students navigate a bleak urban landscape to secure an illegal medical procedure from a predatory outsider.

Title: About Elly
Hint: A weekend getaway by the sea dissolves into a suffocating maze of deception when a mysterious guest vanishes into the waves.
Description: The mysterious disappearance of a kindergarten teacher during a vacation in northern Iran paves the way for a series of deceptions among a group of friends.

Title: Paddington 2
Hint: A polite outsider faces systemic injustice while seeking a rare pop-up treasure for a loved one.
Description: Happily settled with the Brown family, a polite bear takes on several odd jobs to buy the perfect 100th birthday present for his aunt, only for it to be stolen by a master of disguise.

Title: His Girl Friday
Hint: A fast-talking newsman orchestrates a chaotic web of scoops and scandals to prevent his top reporter from trading the deadline for a quiet life.
Description: In this definitive screwball comedy, a cynical newspaper editor uses a sensational murder case to keep his ace reporter and ex-wife from remarrying and leaving the business.

Title: My Life as a Zucchini
Hint: A boy named after a vegetable searches for light in a house full of heavy hearts.
Description: After his mother's sudden death, a young boy is sent to a foster home where he eventually discovers the meaning of friendship and belonging.

Title: Goldfinger
Hint: An obsession with bullion leads to a radioactive plan that threatens the global economy.
Description: A secret agent must thwart a wealthy magnate's plot to contaminate the United States' gold reserve.

Title: Boiling Point
Hint: A single unbroken gaze follows the descent of a high-pressure kitchen into absolute chaos on its busiest night.
Description: An uncompromising look at a head chef battling internal and external pressures during one intense service at a popular London restaurant.

Title: Jeanne Dielman, 23, quai du commerce, 1080 Bruxelles
Hint: A domestic routine is documented through repetitive sequences over three days within a fixed residential setting.
Description: A meticulous clinical observation of a widow's daily domestic labor and the structural breakdown of her rigid schedule over a seventy-two hour period.

Title: Selma
Hint: A prominent historical figure organizes a series of strategic marches in the American South to influence federal legislative policy.
Description: A biographical drama documenting the three-month period in 1965 during which a significant voting rights campaign culminated in a march from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama.

Title: Wadjda
Hint: A young girl in a suburban Riyadh neighborhood attempts to secure personal transportation through participation in a local academic competition.
Description: The film documents a young girl's logistical and social efforts to obtain a specific mode of transport within a Saudi Arabian residential setting.

Title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret.
Hint: An adolescent navigates a geographical relocation while documenting personal milestones and investigating familial religious traditions.
Description: A coming-of-age adaptation centered on a pre-teen's relocation to suburban New Jersey and her subsequent exploration of personal identity and religious plurality.

Title: Lady Bird
Hint: A high school senior navigates educational transitions and interpersonal dynamics within a Northern California municipal setting.
Description: A coming-of-age narrative set in Sacramento, California, focusing on the domestic and academic life of a teenager during her final year of secondary education.

Title: The Wailing
Hint: A rural law enforcement officer examines a sequence of unexplained events and health crises within a secluded village after the arrival of an outsider.
Description: A 2016 South Korean cinematic production that integrates elements of supernatural horror and investigative mystery, focusing on the socioreligious dynamics of a small community.

Title: Eighth Grade
Hint: A pre-adolescent student navigates the final week of her primary education while managing a digital presence.
Description: The narrative examines the social and psychological transitions of a thirteen-year-old girl during the conclusion of her middle school career, utilizing a documentary-style approach to depict contemporary interpersonal interactions.

Title: Happening
Hint: A university student in 1960s France navigates structural and legal obstacles regarding her physical autonomy and educational future.
Description: Based on the autobiographical novel by Annie Ernaux, the film tracks a young academic's singular journey through a restrictive social landscape in 1963.

Title: Never Rarely Sometimes Always
Hint: Two teenage relatives navigate an interstate transit system to access specific healthcare resources within an urban environment.
Description: A minimalist drama documenting the logistical and emotional journey of two cousins as they travel from a rural setting to a metropolitan center for medical purposes.

Title: 120 BPM (Beats Per Minute)
Hint: A grassroots advocacy group in 1990s Paris coordinates public demonstrations and pharmaceutical policy critiques.
Description: The narrative documents the internal dynamics and public actions of an activist collective addressing a public health crisis in France.

Title: Starred Up
Hint: A young individual is prematurely transferred to an adult correctional facility where he encounters an estranged parental figure.
Description: The narrative examines the institutional dynamics and interpersonal friction that occur when a juvenile offender is integrated into a high-security adult prison population.

Title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
Hint: An agricultural collective travels to an urban center to retrieve their displaced supervisor following a series of logistical errors.
Description: A wordless stop-motion feature following a group of farm animals who venture into a metropolitan area to locate their amnesiac owner.

Title: Truman
Hint: An individual facing a terminal prognosis coordinates with a visiting friend to secure the future welfare of a domestic pet.
Description: A terminally ill actor receives a surprise visit from a childhood friend living abroad, leading to several days of emotional navigation and practical planning for his dog's future.

Title: The Tale
Hint: A documentarian re-examines the historical accuracy of a personal childhood narrative after locating a forgotten manuscript.
Description: An investigative inquiry into the reliability of memory and the reconstruction of past events through archived documentation.

Title: Under the Shadow
Hint: A mother and child navigate the structural challenges of a war-torn urban environment while encountering unexplained domestic phenomena.
Description: Set in post-revolutionary Tehran during the 1980s conflict, the film documents the domestic isolation of a former medical student and her daughter as they face both physical aerial threats and reports of metaphysical entities.

Title: Jiang hu er nü
Hint: A woman navigates shifting social structures and personal loyalty within a provincial criminal subculture over several decades.
Description: A multi-decade narrative following a woman's commitment to a local mob leader and her subsequent navigation of a rapidly changing Chinese society following a period of incarceration.

Title: Host
Hint: A group of individuals utilizes a teleconferencing interface to facilitate a spiritualist ritual from their respective domestic environments.
Description: During a period of global isolation, six acquaintances participate in a digital gathering involving a medium, resulting in a series of anomalous occurrences within their private residences.

Title: Schindler's List
Hint: An opportunist’s moral awakening transforms a factory into a sanctuary amidst the darkest chapter of human history.
Description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

Title: Alien
Hint: In the silent vacuum of the cosmos, an uninvited guest turns a commercial haul into a claustrophobic nightmare of survival.
Description: After a space merchant vessel receives an unknown transmission as a distress call, one of the crew is attacked by a mysterious life form and they soon realize that its life cycle has only just begun.

Title: Rear Window
Hint: A confined observer witnesses a chilling secret through a lens while his world remains framed by glass.
Description: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his Greenwich Village courtyard apartment window and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.

Title: City Lights
Hint: A silent wanderer navigates the whims of a wealthy drunkard to fund a miracle for a girl who cannot see him.
Description: A tramp falls in love with a blind flower girl and struggles to raise the money needed for her surgery while befriending an erratic millionaire.

Title: Kumbalangi Nights
Hint: The bioluminescent tides witness the transformation of a broken household of men as they confront a mask of predatory perfection.
Description: In a coastal village, four estranged brothers sharing a dysfunctional home find their lives intertwined through love and loss, challenging the traditional definition of family.

Title: Sarpatta Parambarai
Hint: In a coastal arena of shifting loyalties, a forgotten legacy reclaims its pride through the rhythmic dance of leather and grit.
Description: Set in 1970s North Madras, a young man from a marginalized community rises to revive his boxing clan's honor against all odds.

Title: Aliens
Hint: A lone survivor returns to a silent colony with heavy artillery to face a maternal nightmare lurking in the shadows.
Description: After floating in space for 57 years, a survivor is rescued and reluctantly agrees to accompany a group of colonial marines back to a terraforming colony that has lost contact with Earth, only to find a hive of lethal extraterrestrials.

Title: Apocalypse Now
Hint: A river journey into the heart of madness reveals that the greatest horror lies within the soul of man.
Description: During the Vietnam War, a captain is sent on a dangerous mission into Cambodia to assassinate a renegade colonel who has set himself up as a god among a local tribe.

Title: Your Name.
Hint: Two strangers exchange lives across time and space as a celestial event threatens to erase a forgotten memory.
Description: Two teenagers share a profound, magical connection upon discovering they are swapping bodies, but things become even more complicated when the boy and girl decide to meet in person.

Title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
Hint: A paranoid officer triggers an irreversible apocalypse while leaders debate etiquette in a circular room.
Description: A dark satire where a series of paranoid decisions leads to an accidental nuclear escalation that global leaders struggle to prevent from a subterranean command center.

Title: Das Boot
Hint: Iron walls compress the spirit while the depth claims silence as its only currency.
Description: A realistic and intense portrayal of a German U-boat crew's claustrophobic and harrowing experiences during World War II.

Title: Sunset Blvd.
Hint: A desperate writer finds himself trapped in a decaying mansion serving a forgotten icon whose grasp on reality is as fragile as her celluloid past.
Description: A struggling screenwriter becomes entangled in the life of a former silent film star who is determined to make a grand comeback in the age of talking pictures.

Title: Hamilton
Hint: A relentless immigrant crafts a new nation's rhythm only to realize he cannot outrun the ticking clock of his own ambition.
Description: A filmed version of the original Broadway smash hit musical, telling the story of American Founding Father Alexander Hamilton through a blend of hip-hop, R&B, and show tunes.

Title: Up
Hint: A floating sanctuary drifts toward a forgotten paradise to honor a silent vow made in childhood.
Description: A retired salesman lifts his life from its foundations to embark on a high-altitude quest for a legendary waterfall.

Title: Toy Story 3
Hint: Sentient playthings face a fiery existential crisis before their owner departs for a new chapter of adulthood.
Description: As their owner prepares to depart for college, a group of loyal companions finds themselves mistakenly delivered to a chaotic daycare center.

Title: Children of Paradise
Hint: A mime's silent testimony saves a woman's honor amidst the grand theatricality of a nineteenth-century boulevard.
Description: A cinematic masterpiece following four men who love the same enigmatic woman in the theatrical world of 1830s Paris.

Title: The Father
Hint: A labyrinth of shifting rooms and familiar faces where the architecture of memory slowly collapses into a disorienting haze.
Description: A man struggles to maintain his grip on reality as his memory fades and the world around him begins to change in inexplicable ways.

Title: Chinatown
Hint: A private eye follows a trail of diverted water into a dark ocean of family secrets and municipal corruption.
Description: A private investigator hired to expose an adulterer finds himself caught in a web of deceit, corruption, and murder involving the city's water supply and a powerful family's dark legacy.

Title: Rashomon
Hint: Four contradictory accounts of a single tragedy leave the objective truth buried under the weight of human ego.
Description: A heinous crime is recounted from four different perspectives, challenging the nature of objective truth.

Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Movie: Mugen Train
Hint: A high-speed journey into a collective nightmare requires the heart of a flame to keep the light alive.
Description: A young warrior boards a steam locomotive to investigate a series of mysterious disappearances while trapped within a powerful demon's dreamscape.
